responsibility: Declares the boot runtime's libc compatibility interface, including the wrapper types and prototypes for memory management, file descriptor I/O, environment access, string/memory routines, formatted printing, time/process helpers, and exit/abort entry points. It is the stable C-library abstraction layer that other GNU Modula-2 runtime modules include instead of calling host APIs directly.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration/interface half of the Glibc pair: it provides the generated public prototypes, typedefs, and ABI-facing wrapper types for libc_*, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/Glibc.cc supplies the actual callable wrapper implementations.
